aarg.bonus: Locked to Arcane. A Stasis Trap deals 100 pure damage to the army it catches. Every Warlock Tower (at any level) gives 1 more Magic research. +4 mana regeneration on top of the towers’.
aarg.name: Aarg
aarg.title: Arcanist

aithne.bonus: Sneaking Wayfinders move 100% faster. Crossbowmen deal +1 damage.
aithne.name: Aithne
aithne.title: Assassin

alma.bonus: Locked to Arcane. Interdimensional Trading gives 30% more. Every Mage Tower (at any level) gives 1 more Magic research. +4 mana regeneration on top of the towers’.
alma.name: Alma
alma.title: Arcanist

eliwen.bonus: Locked to Arcane. When a Stasis Trap lets go, the army is Weak for 10 seconds: 25% less damage. Every Grove (at any level) gives 1 more Magic research. +4 mana regeneration on top of the towers’.
eliwen.name: Eliwen
eliwen.title: Arcanist

havva.bonus: Locked to Herbomancy. Harvest gives 5% more food per level (15% / 30% / 45%). Hardened Skin and its upgrades are 20% more effective. Every Mage Tower (at any level) gives 1 more Magic research. +4 mana regeneration on top of the towers’.
havva.name: Havva
havva.title: Herbomancer

hisola.title: Horsemistress

marl.bonus: Berserkers have 10% more chance of a critical blow.

marl.title: Ragemaster

sariel.title: Herbomancer
